context_lines.source: text: Once they had their fill, they put me in a hanging cage at edge of the village.

context_lines.localized: text: 再后来？我也不知被关了多久……一周？两周……？

context_lines.source: text: I don't think I ever got more than an hour of rest between rough breedings.
context_lines.localized: text: 两次粗暴交配之间，我大概从没休息超过一小时。

context_lines.localized: text: 早班巡逻……午班巡逻……谁都能随便用我！

context_lines.source: text: collected by me... ah...! painstakingly...! inch by... ugh... *thick* inch!
context_lines.localized: text: 全是我……啊……辛苦收集的！一寸……呃……*粗大*的一寸！
